text:
MSN 1862 (M) - Amendment 1 - UK Requirements for Deck Ratings
This MSN outlines the qualifying conditions for obtaining deck ratings certificates and able seafarer’s deck certificates.
Documents
Details
Application Information
Please use note that section 5.2 of this Notice is no longer current.
Applications for AB Deck CoPs should be made electronically to seafarers.registry@mcga.gov.uk.
More information can be found in the application form MSF 4310.
Other information
This Merchant Shipping Notice (MSN) sets out and explains the regulatory requirements regarding the implementation of training elements applicable under Chapter II/4 and II/5 of the Standards of Training Certification and Watchkeeping (STCW) Convention and Code, leading to Certificates of Proficiency (CoP) under regulations 17 and 19 in the Merchant Shipping (Standards of Training, Certification and Watchkeeping) Regulations 2022. It outlines the qualifying conditions for obtaining Deck Ratings CoP and an Able Seafarer’s Deck CoP.
Notice to all owners, masters, officers, ratings and those concerned with maritime training.
This notice replaced MSN 1862 on 10 January 2023.
